$comment: The templates we change in agy v1.5.5, each with why and the sha256 of Google's original. Every file in system_prompts/ needs an entry; an empty file drops its section; templates not listed keep Google's text. --apply refuses a binary whose original no longer matches its digest. Rationale and measurements: references/system-prompt.md.

artifacts.tmpl.reason: Web-UI artifact formatting; pushes reports into files instead of chat.

communication_style.tmpl.reason: Drops 'Be concise' truncation bias and redundant clarification rule; keeps markdown, links, and hub branches.

conversation_transcript.tmpl.reason: Same guidance in a fifth of the tokens; reads logs only when compaction summary omits needed detail.

guidelines.tmpl.reason: Drops sandbox-bypass and CAPTCHA lectures; keeps comment preservation.

skills.tmpl.reason: Drops the SKILL.md anatomy lecture and stock builtin guides; omits the section when no user skills exist.

slash_commands.tmpl.reason: Asks the model to promote slash commands it cannot run.
